# She Said Sail

> She Said Sail is a private luxury yacht charter company based in Miami, Florida. The company offers curated on-water experiences designed specifically for women-led group celebrations, including bachelorette parties, milestone birthdays, girls trips, and intimate milestone moments. All experiences are private, professionally crewed, and start from $10,000. Groups range from 4 to 22 guests depending on the experience selected.

She Said Sail operates in Miami, Fort Lauderdale, and Biscayne Bay. The booking process is concierge-led: guests submit a request, a concierge follows up within 24 hours, and a proposal is provided before any deposit is required.

## About

- [About She Said Sail](https://shesaidsail.com/about/): The brand story, founding values, and the philosophy behind the experience design. She Said Sail was built around the idea that milestone moments deserve more than a generic boat rental.

## Experiences

Four curated experiences are available, each designed for a specific type of group and occasion:

- [Monaco Social](https://shesaidsail.com/experience/monaco-social/): Champagne-led yacht experience for birthdays and elevated social groups. Up to 15 guests. Full crew, curated bar, and Bluetooth sound system. Best for groups wanting a social, upscale day on the water.
- [Golden Hour Escape](https://shesaidsail.com/experience/golden-hour-escape/): Sunset charter designed for intimate groups and milestone moments. Up to 12 guests. Quiet, focused on the experience of golden hour over Biscayne Bay. Best for anniversaries, proposals, and smaller celebrations.
- [Rose Day Club](https://shesaidsail.com/experience/rose-day-club/): Afternoon social charter for girls trips, birthdays, and relaxed group days on the water. Up to 15 guests. Rosé service, sun, and social energy without pressure.
- [Pink Palm Club](https://shesaidsail.com/experience/pink-palm-club/): High-energy bachelorette and group celebration experience. Up to 22 guests, the largest capacity available. Music, champagne, and the full Miami skyline. The best-fit for large bachelorette parties.

## Booking

- [Request to Book](https://shesaidsail.com/request-to-book/): Submit a booking request. No deposit required to inquire. A concierge responds within 24 hours to discuss date, group size, and preferences.

## FAQ

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://shesaidsail.com/faq/): Answers to common questions about deposits, group sizes, what is included, weather policy, gratuity, customization, and the booking process.

## Journal

- [The Journal](https://shesaidsail.com/journal/): Stories, planning guides, and ideas for women celebrating in Miami. Topics include bachelorette planning, what to wear on a charter, what to expect on the water, and how to choose the right experience.

## Contact

- [Contact](https://shesaidsail.com/contact/): For general questions, partnership inquiries, or anything that does not fit the booking form. Booking inquiries should go to /request-to-book/ for faster concierge handling.
